original_value: This 16GB SanDisk Ultra Flair USB stick 3.0 is the easy way to transfer documents quickly and simply. With its durable and modern style it is ideal for use at home or in the office for ease of transferring and storing important files from PC’s to laptops. With transfer speeds to drive up to 15 times faster than standard USB 2.0 drives, you can transfer a full-length movie in less than 30 seconds.Featuring a stylish casing of metal, making it a durable companion for you to carry with you wherever you go. This USB stick also has read speeds of up to 130MB/s so that you can be sure it will never let you down. Also comes with a 5 year warranty which ensures peace of mind that your documents will be kept safe.
